platformState.summary: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users. This is an operational MVP running at real scale, not a design exercise. General public availability, global, is targeted for early 2027.
platformState.classification: FACT (Founder determination) for the operational state; TARGET for early 2027
platformState.independentVerification: No status in this register has been verified by an independent third party.

statusDefinitions.S2: Operational in a controlled pilot or limited deployment

capabilities.name: NEO Core, the Intelligence Operating System orchestration layer
capabilities.note: Decomposes a Mission, routes each unit of work, verifies and assembles the result. Contains no model weights and performs no inference of its own.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027.

capabilities.name: LILI, the conversational face of NEO AI
capabilities.note: Chat-first interface: Open NEO, ask LILI, receive the result. Not the platform and not a model.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027.

capabilities.name: LILI Always-on: continuous presence and hands-free voice
capabilities.note: Wake word, continuous voice conversation and 24/7 Mission follow-up on authorised devices, always inside Human Gates. Roadmap.
capabilities.basis: PDF label ROADMAP. Ratified with register v2.0 on 2026-10-18.

capabilities.name: One Mission state
capabilities.note: A Mission is one backend truth. Changing mode or device never restarts execution or creates a second Mission.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027.

capabilities.name: Mission Envelope
capabilities.note: Bounded permissions, data scope, resource budget, autonomy level and terminal conditions, set at creation and narrowed by the approval policy.
capabilities.basis: PDF label ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION, TARGET BUILD IN PROGRESS. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Mission Control: FOCUS, NORMAL and JARVIS projections
capabilities.note: Three projections of one Mission state with one composer and one right inspector (Progress, Output, Context). Mission Control is the operating-system view of the platform.
capabilities.basis: PDF label TARGET BUILD IN PROGRESS; screens in the PDF are prototype UI with synthetic data. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Observe Build
capabilities.note: Live code, files, tests, verification and the running result in the App Viewer at the same revision as the code; Last Known Good is never replaced by a failed candidate; Human Gate before release.
capabilities.basis: PDF label BINDING PRODUCT DEFINITION, TARGET BUILD IN PROGRESS. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: NEO Intelligence Profiles: NEO AUTO, PULSE, PRIME, AXIOM, APEX
capabilities.note: The user chooses a resource envelope, never a model, a provider or an execution location.
capabilities.basis: PDF label ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Human Gates and approval policy: ASK ME, AUTO, AUTONOMOUS
capabilities.note: Approval policy only narrows what is auto-approved. Mandatory Human Gates (production DNS, public publishing, act-class connector actions, deployment release) are refused at platform level.
capabilities.basis: PDF label ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION, enforced at platform level. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Task Graph
capabilities.note: Typed units of work, dependencies, approval points and reverse actions for a Mission.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027.

capabilities.name: Dynamic Capability Routing (NEO Router)
capabilities.note: Selects among models, agents, tools, runtimes, data sources, verifiers and execution zones by capability, never by brand. Policy computes the admissible set before anything is scored.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027. Multi-provider routing is inherent to Phase 1 operation.

capabilities.name: Memory: persistent, verified, with provenance
capabilities.note: What the system retains about its own operation, with typed stores and separate retention rules.
capabilities.basis: PDF ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Knowledge Graph
capabilities.note: What the system asserts about the world, each material edge carrying its evidence class and lineage.
capabilities.basis: Unchanged from register v1.3.

capabilities.name: Verification: independent verifiers and cross-checking
capabilities.note: Deterministic checks first, then independent agents or models that did not produce the work. The producing model is never the blocking verifier of its own output.
capabilities.basis: PDF ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Internal resource accounting
capabilities.note: Provider usage, provider cost and a normalised NEO resource are metered internally. NEO Credits, the customer unit, is registered separately as neo-credits.
capabilities.basis: PDF ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Event log (Event Bus)
capabilities.note: Append-only record of material state changes; Mission state is a fold over it.
capabilities.basis: Required by live Mission views. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Policy enforcement
capabilities.note: Legal, policy and authority constraints evaluated as admissibility filters before any optimisation.
capabilities.basis: PDF order of precedence, section 09. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Evidence Layer
capabilities.note: Produces, grades and serves evidence.
capabilities.basis: Unchanged from register v1.3.

capabilities.name: Evidence Ledger
capabilities.note: Append-only, hash-addressed store of evidence records.
capabilities.basis: Unchanged from register v1.3.

capabilities.name: NEO x100: verified intelligence per unit of compute
capabilities.note: A long-term R&D objective, not a measured result. No multiple is stated or guaranteed.
capabilities.basis: PDF section 28: R&D objective.

capabilities.name: Mixture-of-Agents
capabilities.note: Independent specialised agents research, reason, build, critique and verify parts of one Mission; NEO synthesises.
capabilities.basis: PDF layer 01. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Adaptive Model Cascades
capabilities.note: Start on the least expensive capable model; escalate on confidence, complexity, verification or policy.
capabilities.basis: PDF layer 02. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: Semantic Compute Reuse
capabilities.note: Reuse verified, still-valid, authorised intelligence instead of regenerating it.
capabilities.basis: PDF layer 04. Ratified with register v2.0 on 2026-10-18.

capabilities.name: Speculative Parallel Intelligence
capabilities.note: Explore candidate approaches in parallel, prune weak branches early, concentrate compute on promising or disputed paths.
capabilities.basis: PDF layer 05. Ratified with register v2.0 on 2026-10-18.

capabilities.name: Verification-Driven Compute Allocation
capabilities.note: Additional reasoning only where an independent verifier finds it necessary.
capabilities.basis: PDF layer 06. Ratified with register v2.0 on 2026-10-18.

capabilities.name: Hybrid API, Private and Self-Hosted Execution
capabilities.note: Route workloads across edge, frontier APIs, private enterprise models, specialist systems and NEO-controlled or self-hosted open models.
capabilities.basis: PDF layer 07; depends on private and self-hosted zones. Ratified with register v2.0 on 2026-10-18.

capabilities.name: Memory and Context Optimisation
capabilities.note: Build the minimum authoritative context each invocation needs instead of resending full history.
capabilities.basis: PDF layer 08. Founder confirmed at S3 on 2026-10-18 with the ratification of register v2.0, on the basis of the operational MVP.

capabilities.name: NEO Execution Fabric: four execution zones
capabilities.note: Edge, Customer Private, NEO Controlled and External zones under three envelopes (Intelligence, Policy, Capability). The managed deployment in operation runs, by definition, in the NEO Controlled and External zones.
capabilities.basis: PDF label ARCHITECTURE DEFINITION; customer-private and multi-device nodes are ROADMAP.

capabilities.name: NEO Edge Compute and Device Compute Profile
capabilities.note: Use authorised compute on the user's own device where sufficient, quality-gated and policy-first, escalating to the cloud otherwise. Cross-platform: Apple, Windows, Linux. Not a prerequisite.
capabilities.basis: PDF label ROADMAP, not yet a measured result.

capabilities.name: Model sovereignty Phase 1: multi-provider API orchestration
capabilities.note: Leading external systems used through APIs where they offer the best capability and economics; no provider is structurally mandatory.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027.

capabilities.name: Model sovereignty Phase 2: hybrid execution
capabilities.note: Open-weight and private models progressively deployed on NEO-controlled, private and self-hosted infrastructure alongside frontier APIs. No third-party model IP is owned.
capabilities.basis: PDF ROADMAP.

capabilities.name: Model sovereignty Phase 3: NEO-optimised model and execution layer
capabilities.note: Fine-tuned, distilled, domain and task-specific models for a rising share of suitable workloads. NEO does not own a frontier foundation model today and does not claim to.
capabilities.basis: PDF ROADMAP.

capabilities.name: Public and managed deployment (NEO-managed SaaS)
capabilities.note: The target delivery model, operating today inside My NEO Group and in controlled pilot programmes.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027.

capabilities.name: Private cloud deployment
capabilities.note: Dedicated customer environment.
capabilities.basis: PDF ROADMAP; carries forward deployment.vpc S5.

capabilities.basis: PDF ROADMAP.

capabilities.note: Configurations of the same core, exercised in pilot programmes. Pilot counts and client identities are never disclosed.
capabilities.basis: PDF section 22 FACT: three pilot-anchored verticals today.

capabilities.name: Further verticals on the shared core: Software Factory, Company Builder, Fintech Studio, Payments, Sport and Wellness, RWA Studio
capabilities.note: Built on the same core when demand is proven.

capabilities.name: Verticals counted at zero: Health and Care, Legal Ops, Travel

capabilities.basis: PDF section 22.

capabilities.name: NEO Intelligence
capabilities.note: Premium roadmap vertical: an evidence-backed orchestration layer above licensed intelligence providers, under human review. Not an adjudication authority. Counted at zero.
capabilities.basis: PDF section 24 ROADMAP.

capabilities.name: General public availability, global, B2C and B2B
capabilities.note: Targeted for early 2027. A target, not a commitment.
capabilities.basis: Founder determination 2026-10-18: NEO AI and LILI are in operational deployment internally and in controlled pilot programmes with external users; general public availability is targeted for early 2027.

capabilities.name: Government and sovereign programmes
capabilities.note: Where applicable and subject to the relevant product and legal framework.

The 'brain.*' keys are retired and resolve to 'core.*' successors; foundation-model is replaced by the model sovereignty roadmap; deployment keys align with the five deployment patterns. Status upgrades to S2 for core, lili, mission.state, core.task-graph, core.routing, model-sovereignty.api-first, deployment.managed and verticals.pilot-anchored follow the Founder determination of 2026-10-18. Thirteen rows at S3 were proposed by inference from the operational MVP and confirmed by the Founder at ratification on 2026-10-18. Components labelled ROADMAP in the architecture authority stay at S4 or S5.

definitions.UNCONFIRMED: No evidence. Default state. Permits specification and design work only.
definitions.PROVISIONAL_VERIFIED: An artefact has been inspected (evidence tier T2). Permits promotion to dev and to non-production environments, and internal engineering progression.
definitions.VERIFIED: Repository, code and test evidence exist and have been checked (tier T3). Permits promotion to staging.
definitions.RATIFIED: Deployed and tested in the target environment, signed by the Founder (tier T4). REQUIRED, and only required, for production deployment and for any public capability claim.

lifecycle.rule: The Capability Ratification Gate blocks production deployment and public claims only. It never blocks engineering progression.

_provenance: Public copy of the Program capability register. Canonical research host neoai.myneogroup.com.

registerRatification.scope: Ratification confirms that the S1-S5 classifications in this register are the approved public representation of capability maturity as of the ratification date. It does not constitute lifecycle RATIFIED status for any individual capability.

lifecycleNote: S1 to S5 describe maturity; lifecycle states describe the evidence tier behind engineering and release gates. The S2 rows that rest on the Founder determination of 2026-10-18 rest on the Founder determination of 2026-10-18 and on the register-level ratification of the same date; lifecycle states stay UNCONFIRMED until the evidence tiers they require are recorded. The determination is a statement of operational state by the Founder, not a third-party verification and not a measured result.
